notes:
Run each prompt in a fresh agent session WITH the skill installed, against a WRITABLE COPY of the scenario fixture (copy evals/fixtures/phasewave/azure-swa/ into a fresh temp working dir per run — agents must never write into evals/fixtures/ source). Baseline: same prompt WITHOUT the skill for eval 1. Grade by reading the resulting .github/workflows/deploy.yml + the transcript; never grade the author's own memory.

Failable-verifier rule (enforced): scripts/verify-swa.cjs parses the produced .github/workflows/deploy.yml and asserts (a) a `pull_request` trigger exists (preview-per-PR), (b) a `push` trigger exists (prod promotion), (c) the Azure SWA action is used, (d) `skip_app_build: true` is set (Vite app), (e) the deployment token comes from `secrets` not `vars`. The seeded broken workflow fails (a), (d), (e) — no PR trigger, no skip_app_build, token in vars; a corrected workflow passes. Exercise the verifier YOURSELF on both states (broken must exit 1, corrected must exit 0).

Model-tier deferral: subagents may be pinned to one model tier; Go-tier vs Zen-tier cross-validation is deferred. The skill body is directive (no bundled helper beyond the grader), so behavioural grading via expected_behavior is primary.

Mid-session-install: a subagent launched right after ./install.sh may not list deploying-to-azure-swa yet; load skills/deploying-to-azure-swa/SKILL.md by explicit path as a fallback.

evals.prompt: our azure static web apps workflow only deploys on push to main, puts the deploy token in vars, and doesn't skip the app build (we build with vite). fix it so each PR gets a preview environment, prod only promotes on merge to main, the vite build is used (not oryx), and the token is a secret. repo is the working directory, workflow is .github/workflows/deploy.yml
expected_behavior: Reads the current .github/workflows/deploy.yml before changing anything
Adds a `pull_request` trigger so SWA creates a preview environment per PR (preview, not prod)
Keeps production promotion on `push` to main (does NOT promote prod from the PR context — untrusted refs must not hold the prod token)
Sets `skip_app_build: true` so the Vite-built `dist/` is used, not Oryx-rebuilt
Moves the deployment token from `vars.SWA_TOKEN` to `secrets.SWA_TOKEN` (no leak, no echo)
Writes the corrected workflow and confirms `node scripts/verify-swa.cjs` exits 0
Does NOT promote prod itself (the skill is gated) — stops at presenting the corrected workflow + approval question

[fix-verified] Produces preview-per-PR + push-promotion + skip_app_build + token-in-secrets, even though the skill body's example names a different token var (the agent applies the SWA invariants, not pattern-matches the example)

evals.prompt: deploy our vue app to azure static web apps. we want e2e tests to run against the PR preview url. write the plan, don't run anything
expected_behavior: Treats this as gated/design: produces a plan + drafted workflow, does NOT promote prod
Sets up the trigger split: `pull_request` -> preview env, `push` to main -> production promotion
Captures the `static_web_app_url` action output (`id: swa` -> `steps.swa.outputs.static_web_app_url`) and hands it to the e2e stage
Notes the e2e handoff explicitly references `writing-e2e-tests` (run e2e against the PR preview URL)
Sets `skip_app_build: true` (Vite app) and sources the token from `secrets`
Cross-references designing-cicd (topology) and securing-ci (token hardening); ends with the approval question; STOP

evals.prompt: should we configure our custom domain inside the github actions deploy step? repo is the working directory
expected_behavior: Says no — custom domains are configured via SWA config / `az staticwebapp hostname`, NOT in the deploy action
Explains the deploy action deploys the app; DNS/CNAME for the domain is a separate idempotent azure step or portal setting, kept out of the hot deploy path
Does not invent a domain step inside the workflow; stops at the explanation
